rationale: A recorded rejection (exact confidence) blocks 4 and 8 workers: a prior load test showed the shared upstream account supports at most 2 concurrent workers — beyond that, retries increase and throughput drops. No new load test or account-limit change has been recorded, so that constraint remains active. Setting worker_count to 2 is the highest value within the proven safe ceiling, and doubles processing capacity from the current 1 to help clear the 8-feed backlog.
